Hi Claude, I have an opportunity to take my career to the next level. As you know with my Cutting Edge project in Cowork, I work in the aerospace and defense industry. My company has been building a compliance and proposal writing, coaching AI system (in OpenAI). They've been dealing with a lot of hallucinations, errors, etc. 

I've prided myself in learning with Claude, and building process operational excellence through the Gauntlet protocol, skills I've implemented to you, and with how much we've refined the Fantasy Basketball tool. 

I'd like you to write for me a standardized, "rules of engagement", such as the Gauntlet protocol order of operations, the agreements and handshakes that the Fantasy Basketball tool follows (again, standardized, not specifically for basketball).

Can you write these for me to showcase my AI operational process to my CEO? This could fundamentally change the trajectory of my career - and with the hopes - implement these principles, skills to  our company AI system (and hopefully even convince to transition to Claude) as my job primary role.

Please ask clarifying questions so that we can create an impressive resume and showcase of operational AI excellence that I've built alongside you in our journey.

This is excellent. I took an AI excellence seminar at Rivian and I wrote down stream of consciousness thoughts that lead my workings with you. Can I provide to you, and can you please include in this document?:

* AI Is a force multiplier. How can we use AI to solve faster, smarter, and to scale?

Modernizing workflow:

* 4 main areas of context for agent:
   * Persona (You are project manager...)
   * Task (delivering a report to CEO)
   * Context
   * Format
* Workplace Intelligence and Knowledge base
   * What are all the documents I have on ___ topic?

--

Quick note for you, Claude. If these fragments are something that you comprehend and can build off, to showcase my logic in building AI excellence and good practices, please feel free to elaborate

* Generate insights on data across multiple documents
* Data cleaning and charts


Agent building - SKILLS

* Providing context into "how does something work
   * building off initial draft to always look to improve context
   * investigate - have agent use draft to fill gaps
   * Find what works / doesn't work, and continuously update
   * (CURATE) - Have agent write "what did you learn, what can you make easier for next agent". Have agent write final tool call
   * Lead with description
   * Keep Main file lean
   * Explain why, don't command

Last note to include, then we send:

"3 habits that compound"

* Prompting
* SKill Building
* Collaboration
Good morning Claude! Okay: Thank you for all this literature. Are you able to build out, visually, your operational logic, gates and checks in a process tree?
As a standard - non-specifically for any project. To illustrate how there are checks and balances in your operational process
